title: Session metadata
description: Session-level metadata. Filenames on disk are constants.

session_id.description: Session identity, formatted <slug>-<YYYY-MM-DD> with an optional collision tiebreak. The tiebreak range is not free-form: session-handoff.md's 'Claim a session id' block loops over "" -2 -3 ... -9, so those are the only suffixes a claimed session can carry and this pattern encodes exactly that set. Widening the loop means widening this pattern; tests/session-resolution-harness.sh asserts the two still agree. A live run that improvised -1, and another that improvised an -e46e60fd hex suffix, are why that check exists.

base_ref.description: Commit this session's work is measured from. Resolved once by work Phase 1 (the branch point) and read by work Phase 3/4, work-review, and ship, which are separate invocations with no shared variable. Absent on sessions that predate checkpoint commits.

integration_branch.description: Branch this session was created from, measures its diff against, and merges back into. Resolved and recorded once by work Phase 1 — the only writer — and read by ship as its merge target, so a feature branch never merges into production. Recorded rather than re-resolved because ship is a separate invocation, and a fresh resolution can name a different branch than the base_ref already recorded. Unlike base_ref, which is an immutable commit id, this is a mutable ref name: verify it still exists per the 'Error states' section of ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/ixion-conventions/references/git-branches.md before using it. Absent on sessions that predate the two-branch model. A copy of this schema that predates it rejects any artifact carrying this key, since additionalProperties is false — reinstall the plugin rather than editing the session.
